label: Construction Superintendent
summary: Two Building and Construction Resumes against Web Designing and Finance.
job_description:
Wood needs a Construction Superintendent to run day-to-day site work on a structural, mechanical and piping package, owning schedule and site safety.

What we need:
- N6 (National Diploma) – 10 years experience
- S4 (Higher National Diploma) – 8 years experience
- B Degree – 6 years experience

The original posting also asked for the following, which this demo does not gate on: Trade (Boilermaker, Fitter, Electrician) – 12 years experience.
